question: Can accomplishment still occur by fate even when the mantra remains averse?
premises: Fate can influence the outcome of actions.
Accomplishment may still arise in an undertaking.
The mantra or world may remain turned away.
inference: Even if the mantra is averse, accomplishment in action may still occur by fate.
uncertainties: The subject of 'parāṅmukhaḥ' could refer to the mantra or to people; both readings are possible.
plain_english: By fate, accomplishment in an action may still occur, even if it remains turned away.
